page.overview:
Who is The Wandering Doomed?

The Wandering Doomed are character versions of the card "The Wandering Doomed", appearing in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Capsule Monsters anime.

The Wandering Doomed reside at the graveyard in the World of Capsule Monsters.

The Wandering Doomed, along with Wood Remains surrounded Yami Yugi, Joey Wheeler, Téa Gardner, Tristan Taylor and Solomon Muto, after they arrived at the graveyard. The humans summoned Celtic Guardian, Baby Dragon, Thunder Kid and Happy Lover from their capsules to defend themselves. The first three defeated a number of the doomed, while Happy Lover was terrorized by them. The humans were still outnumbered and unable to escape, so they freed more monsters from their capsules, including Flame Swordsman and Dark Witch, who were able to quickly dispose of the remaining doomed and Wood Remains.
